integrity: Exact global scheme established by affine-chart proof. Reproducible arithmetic checks are finite examples only. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The full relative-Frobenius kernel is assumed split as mu_p^r direct sum alpha_p^s. The theorem concerns the canonical universal p-closure zero scheme of invariant lines, not arbitrary moduli of subgroup embeddings or nonlinear foliations. Historical priority is assessed rather than independently certified.
title: Frobenius-thickened parameter schemes of \(p\)-closed invariant foliations
